text:
Alex M: Quick sync — uploading this week's regional GPU supply vs projected burn. We have a mismatched shape in APAC for the next 7 days. Need quick prioritization.
Samira K: can you paste numbers? I'm in a meeting for 20m but will jump in.
Jin Park: here's a fast snapshot I pulled from the pipeline:
```
cluster,region,available_gpus,projected_gpu_hours_next_7d,buffer_pct
cluster-eu-2,eu-west-2,48,3600,11
cluster-us-west-1,us-west-1,96,4200,12
cluster-ap-sg-1,ap-southeast-1,24,2400,0
cluster-ap-tok,ap-northeast-1,16,1600,-5
```
Alex M: AP clusters have near-zero or negative buffer. That ap-sg node group had a preemptible instance eviction spike yesterday.
OpsBot: [alert] cluster-ap-sg-1: instance-eviction-rate=7% over 12h, network-retries=1200
Leah R: we also have inter-region egress for model sync hitting billing thresholds. If we shift heavy reranks to us-west it reduces egress but increases latency.
Ryan ICP: cost quick calc: moving 1k gpu-hours cross-region = approx $7k in egress vs $3k local infra delta. Leaning to keep in-region unless latency >120ms.
Samira K: Ok. Proposals: 1) temporary soft-cap on non-priority job queues in APAC, 2) increase preemptible budget to smooth spot churn, 3) spin up 8x p4d in ap-tok reserved for scheduled spikes. Thoughts?
Jin Park: prefer 1 + 2 for now. 3 needs procurement lead time (days). Also can we re-route eval-heavy batch to dedicated us-west pool tonight? low-priority tag = `batch:eval`
Alex M: Jin, can you run quick lifecheck on cluster-ap-sg-1 and paste node-level errors? Use: `kubectl get nodes -l topology=ap-sg -o wide` and `kubectl logs -l daemon=nvlink-manager`
Jin Park: pasted below:
```
NODE: ap-sg-1-node-07  STATUS: Ready   GPU: 4/4
NODE: ap-sg-1-node-09  STATUS: NotReady  Kernel OOM events x3
LOGS: nvlink-manager: warning: timeout syncing nvlink on /dev/nvidia0
```
Leah R: Kernel OOM on a node with 4 GPUs indicates either driver update flakiness or runaway mem growth in a pod. I muted scheduled model training on those nodes.
Alex M: Action items:
- Samira: approve soft-cap on non-prod APAC queues (today)
- Jin: cordon + drain Node-09, file infra ticket with kernel logs (INC-AP-412)
- Leah: update routing policy for reranks to prefer us-west for >=2x token batches
- Ryan: confirm cost numbers for 7/14/30 day shifts
Samira K: approve soft-cap. I'll post the policy patch in #eng-infra in 10m :thumbsup:
Jin Park: cordon/drain done. Filing INC-AP-412 now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-AP-412
OpsBot: [deploy] policy-patch applied to queue-system at 2026-03-18T11:12:03Z
Alex M: thanks. Will reconvene tomorrow morning — if APAC buffer doesn't hit >8% by 08:00 UTC we'll escalate to procurement for spot-reserve.
Ryan ICP: noted, I'll run cost sims and post numbers by EOD.
Leah R: Also tracking downstream customer-impact for low-priority stalls — putting a metric on the dashboard (token-queue-wait) and alert at 30s.
Samira K: thanks everyone. Good quick tempo.
